title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 7: David wants to build a house for God, and Yahweh promises through Nathan to build David a house.

questions.text: What did David point out to Nathan the prophet?
questions.explanation: David said, "I dwell in a house of cedar, but God's ark dwells within curtains."

answers.text: The ark was still in Obed-Edom's house
His house was cedar, but God's ark was within curtains
The Philistines still threatened all Israel
The people had no place left to worship

questions.text: What was Nathan's first answer to the king?
questions.explanation: Nathan said, "Go, do all that is in your heart; for Yahweh is with you."

answers.text: "Let your son do it after you"
"Go, do all that is in your heart"

questions.text: When did Yahweh's word come to Nathan?
questions.explanation: That same night, Yahweh's word came to Nathan.

questions.text: According to Yahweh, how had he moved around since bringing Israel up?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he had not lived in a house, but had moved around in a tent and in a tabernacle.

answers.text: In a tent and in a tabernacle
In a palace with the kings

questions.text: From where did Yahweh say he took David?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people."

answers.text: From the court of King Saul
From the land of the Philistines
From the sheep pen, following the sheep
From the house of the priests

questions.text: Who did Yahweh say would build a house for his name?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he would set up David's offspring after him, and "He will build a house for my name."

questions.text: If David's offspring commits iniquity, how will Yahweh chasten him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men."

answers.text: By taking away his kingdom at once
With the rod and stripes of men
By sending a great flood on him
By giving him to the Philistines

questions.text: From whom did Yahweh say he had taken his loving kindness?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said his loving kindness would not depart from David's offspring, "as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you."

questions.text: What did David ask when he sat before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: David said, "Who am I, Lord Yahweh, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?"

answers.text: "Why may I not build your house?"
"Who am I, Lord Yahweh, and what is my house?"

questions.text: What did David say about Yahweh's words near the end of his prayer?
questions.explanation: David said, "Now, O Lord Yahweh, you are God, and your words are truth."

answers.text: They are for the priests alone
